# Define stamp detector. Seed-color cells define a fixed-orientation mask; occurrences require background-zero cells.
def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    coords=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    if not coords: return g
    minr=min(r for r,c in coords); minc=min(c for r,c in coords)
    shape={(r-minr,c-minc) for r,c in coords}
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); mh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; mw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    matches=[]
    for r in range(H-mh+1):
        for c in range(W-mw+1):
            if all(g[r+dr][c+dc]==0 or g[r+dr][c+dc]==5 for dr,dc in shape):
                # Avoid counting exact source shape only; allowing marker cells permits stamps to overlap source.
                matches.append((r,c))
    for r,c in matches:
        for dr,dc in shape: g[r+dr][c+dc]=5
    return g, matches

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    counts=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    marker=min(counts, key=counts.get)
    coords=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==marker]
    minr=min(r for r,c in coords); minc=min(c for r,c in coords)
    shape={(r-minr,c-minc) for r,c in coords}
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); mh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; mw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    matches=[]
    # exact matches over background color 0, or existing marker cells for overlaps
    background=min((v for v in counts if v!=marker),key=lambda v:counts[v])
    for r in range(H-mh+1):
        for c in range(W-mw+1):
            if all(g[r+dr][c+dc] in (background,marker) for dr,dc in shape): matches.append((r,c))
    for r,c in matches:
        for dr,dc in shape: g[r+dr][c+dc]=marker
    return g, matches

def transform(grid):
    """Stamp every occurrence of the rare marker shape over zero cells."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(v for row in out for v in row)

    top = min(r for r, c in points)
    left = min(c for r, c in points)

    height = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1

    # The marker is drawn over zeros. Existing marker cells are allowed so a

    for r in range(H - height + 1):
        for c in range(W - width + 1):
            if all(out[r + dr][c + dc] in (0, marker) for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:

    return out
